title: Sage anim_graph record
description: A anim_graph record (AnimGraphRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another anim_graph record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

initial.description: The base layer's first state, and where an animator goes when its saved state is not in the graph any more. (string, default "")

states.description: The base layer's states, by name. (Dictionary<string, AnimState>)

clip.description: The clip it plays, by name, from the animator's model; leave out for a blend or for nothing. (string)

blend.description: A blend space instead of one clip: 1D over x, 2D over x and y. (AnimBlendSpace)

x.description: The float param along the first axis. (string)

y.description: The float param along the second axis; leave out for a 1D blend. (string)

points.description: The clips and where each sits. (List<AnimBlendPoint>)

x.description: Where it sits on the x axis. (float)

y.description: Where it sits on the y axis (2D only) (float)

points+.description: Adds to "points": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

x.description: Where it sits on the x axis. (float)

y.description: Where it sits on the y axis (2D only) (float)

points-.description: Removes these from "points" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

x.description: Where it sits on the x axis. (float)

y.description: Where it sits on the y axis (2D only) (float)

loop.description: Whether the clip loops; a one-shot holds its last frame. (bool)

speed.description: Playback rate: 1 is as authored, 2 twice as fast. (float)

fade.description: How long entering it cross-fades; left out, the graph's fade. Unit: s. At least 0. (float?)

ease.description: The curve entering it cross-fades along; left out, the graph's ease. (Ease?)

tags.description: Free words for whatever reads the animator (Animators.HasTag) (List<string>)

tags+.description: Adds to "tags": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

tags-.description: Removes these from "tags" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

rootMotion.description: Root motion (base layer only): None, Rotation (turns about up), Translation (moves across the ground) or Full; what it takes out of the root joint moves the body instead, so feet do not slide. (RootMotionMode)

rootMotionY.description: With Translation or Full: the root's height moves the body too, instead of gravity (a climb, a vault); off, only across the ground. (bool)

transitions.description: Where it can go, tried in order: the first that matches wins. (List<StateTransition>)

on.description: An input's name: only when that input arrives at the entity (any name; registered ones too) (string)

when.description: Only while this holds, asked about the activator with the machine as the other. (ICondition)

after.description: Only once the machine has been in the state this long; 0 = no wait. Unit: s. At least 0. (float)

then.description: What taking it does, between the old state's exit and the new one's enter. (List<IAction>)

then+.description: Adds to "then": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

then-.description: Removes these from "then" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).
